notes: Simulation, because a clicker with rebirth multipliers is the incremental family the index files under this genre — the parkour-free city is scenery for the click loop, not a second genre. world-open is the genre default and the right read of the answer's neighbourhood-sized modern city: one shared walkable map with no personal plot, streets, buildings and parks explorable in any order. Incremental Simulator keeps its shape; path-circulation is the street grain that makes the city walkable and settlement-density is the built-up block density the answer asked for, while social-hub and gate-progression were dropped because the prompt has no shop and no gated zones. Decided without a user: 'interior-style decorative detail' was read as dressing rather than enterable buildings, so the build stays on P0; the rebirth button and the admin panel are screen UI the prompt puts on screen rather than pads to place; and 'no labels around the map or on the ground' is carried as a build constraint that no text geometry is generated.
